Errors were still ongoing at the end of the log (03:59), never recovered. No later deploy fixed it, so the impact window is 02:14:18 through at least the end of the log at 03:59:27, still active.

**On-call handoff**

**Root cause.** Gateway deploy `dep-4471` (a.novak, "connection-per-request for pool isolation") flipped `gateway.pool.perRequest` from `false` to `true`. The pool now hands out a fresh connection per request instead of reusing one, and it exhausts fast: fixed size 20, `in_use` pinned at 20, and `waiting` climbs into the hundreds. Every failing request logs `ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED`, then a `503`.

**Impact window.** Started 2026-03-14 02:14:18 UTC, first error on `req-07401`. Still ongoing as of the last log line, 03:59:27 UTC. Gateway only. Worker pool stayed healthy the whole time.

**Rollback.** `dep-4471` on the gateway. It applied at 02:12–02:14 UTC, right before the errors began.
